card.name: Body weight numbers before kg
card.fires_on: The space or digit right before a body-weight figure in kilograms, usually after 'weighing' or 'weigh at least'. It also fires in the digits of weights such as 12, 10 or 30 before 'kg'.

modes.label: Space after 'weighing'
modes.description: The blank or bracket just before a weight number that is followed by kg.
modes.example: a 19-month old child weighing<< >>12 kg was seen in the hospital

modes.label: Digits inside a weight
modes.description: A digit within a weight value that is about to be followed by a kg or lbs unit.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward kilogram unit words and number words like ten and twenty, and away from gram and mill.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a patient's weight in kilograms is being written.
